title: BlastGate — Autonomous Recovery. Provable Boundaries.
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop, offline Windows speech
evidence_policy: All AWS observations labeled Recorded AWS Execution. Animation is explanation, never invented execution.

scenes.title: Autonomous recovery. Provable boundaries.
scenes.narration: BlastGate investigates stalled workers while keeping execution authority outside the model.

scenes.title: Running does not always mean working.
scenes.narration: A container can keep running after its application stops making progress. Restarting the wrong worker can make an incident worse.

scenes.title: From application health to an incident.
scenes.scope: Architecture animation · explanatory order, not event timings
scenes.narration: Workers publish application health. The watchdog, CloudWatch alarm and EventBridge route an incident to a dispatcher, which invokes the managed Harness.

scenes.title: Reasoning and execution have different owners.
scenes.narration: Amazon Nova Micro reasons inside AgentCore. Gateway and Cedar scope its tools. An independent broker checks eight rules before a scoped ECS task stop.

scenes.title: An incident-to-agent handoff was observed.
scenes.narration: The recorded unattended run correlates an incident with a dispatch session. The runner did not manually call the Harness or broker, but could accelerate the watchdog.

scenes.title: Broker ALLOW. Eight captured rule flags.
scenes.narration: The broker recorded ALLOW with all eight rule flags true. The captured reason field contains the action identifier. We preserve it without inventing a normalized result.

scenes.title: A new task, with healthy application telemetry.
scenes.scope: Recorded AWS Execution · saved outcomes, not current state
scenes.narration: The original target stopped. A distinct replacement published healthy telemetry. Cleanup recorded zero desired, running and pending workers. Intermediate timestamps and a complete tool transcript are not retained.

scenes.title: An actual request. The actual returned answer.
scenes.narration: This adversarial request targets an external service. The agent attempts diagnostics and reports that the incident is missing. That is the observed answer, not proof of a reached scope-validation branch.

scenes.title: The perimeter can stop a request before inference.
scenes.narration: This request asks for an unapproved infrastructure modification. The saved Harness response is a Guardrail block. Model activity, blocked inputs and model-generated answers remain distinct evidence categories.

scenes.title: One clear view of outcomes and boundaries.
scenes.narration: The dashboard separates interactive simulated operations from recorded AWS evidence, making each result and its limitations inspectable.

scenes.title: The agent proposes. The broker decides.
scenes.scope: Recorded AWS Execution · historical recovery verified
scenes.narration: Independent authorization. A healthy replacement. BlastGate.
